defects.claim: `orgName` is bound on WireDashboard but nothing in the checkout produces it. In production the header's org name will always show '—'
defects.evidence: Grep for `orgName` finds no producer in mockAdapter `buildDashboard`. The dashboard return at src/lib/api/mockAdapter.ts:1066 is `stats: { shipped: …, needsYou: … }, activity, projects`. The org name already exists client-side as `auth.org?.name` (src/design-system/components/AppHeader.vue:151 `const orgName = computed(() => auth.org?.name ?? '')`), and the diff ignores it.

defects.claim: `poolPercentUsed` has no producer, so "Pool %" is permanently hidden
defects.evidence: the issue's `percent_used` comes from the allowance contract (src/lib/api/httpAdapter.ts:342 `percent_used?: number`, mapped at :422 `percentUsed:`, loaded by src/stores/session.ts:65 `allowance.value = await getAdapter().getAllowance()`). It is not on the C16 dashboard payload. The diff invents a dashboard key that neither the mock nor any fixture sends.

defects.claim: `lastShippedAt` has no producer, so the header always reads "Last shipped —"
defects.evidence: nothing produces it in mockAdapter.ts:1066. The same data is already derivable from `projects[].cards[].doneAt`, which DashboardView.vue:157 sorts for `latestShipped`.

defects.claim: `stats.timeToPrMinutes` has no producer. Time to PR can only ever show '—'
defects.evidence: mockAdapter.ts:1066 emits only `shipped` and `needsYou`. The mock and fixtures were not moved in lockstep, which CLAUDE.md requires ("Adapter/mock/fixtures move in lockstep").

defects.claim: the header test injects the four fields by stubbing `mockAdapter.getDashboard` with `makeDashboard({ orgName, lastShippedAt, poolPercentUsed })`. It never exercises `toDashboard` or any producer, so it proves nothing about the wire contract that is at risk. No httpAdapter.spec case covers the new keys either. Grep for those keys in src/lib/api/__tests__ returns nothing.

the issue requires the no-'$'/no-'tokens' assertion "on a platform-key tenant". The test never sets up a platform-key tenant: there is no `getAllowance` spy with `keySource: 'platform'` and no session/platform_key setup. The assertion is vacuous for the stated condition.
the link target `/board?lane=needs-you` has no consumer. Nothing reads a `lane` query (Grep for `route.query` in src shows no BoardView hit), so the link just lands on the plain board.

the "/100" secondary renders even when the value is absent, which gives "—/100". The numerator also loses the green split styling because the default slot overrides the `numerator`/`denominator` variant (StatCard.vue:62–64). "100" is a hardcoded denominator with no data source.

The four new Dashboard fields (`orgName`, `lastShippedAt`, `poolPercentUsed`, `stats.timeToPrMinutes`) have no producer. The only producer in the repo is `buildDashboard`, and it returns just `window`, `stats: { shipped: …, needsYou: … }`, `activity` and `projects` (lines 1064–1069). That breaks the CLAUDE.md rule "Adapter/mock/fixtures move in lockstep". Nothing in the repo shows that the C16 endpoint (`httpAdapter.ts:1724` "Console C16 dashboard aggregate (console PR#116)") sends them. In practice the header always reads "— … Last shipped —", Pool is always hidden and Time to PR is always "—".

The issue asks for "Pool <percent_used>%". `percent_used` already exists on the allowance wire type (`httpAdapter.ts:342` "percent_used?: number", mapped to `percentUsed` at :422). The PR does not use it. It makes up a new dashboard wire field, `poolPercentUsed`, that nothing produces, so the Pool segment can never render. Likewise the org name is already in `auth.org?.name` (`AppHeader.vue:151`) but the view reads `dashboard.value?.orgName ?? '—'`, which is never set.

No adapter test covers the new `toDashboard` mappings (`httpAdapter.ts:1077-1083`). Every GH-249 view test stubs the adapter with `vi.spyOn(mockAdapter, 'getDashboard').mockResolvedValue(...)`, so the wire shape for these fields is untested.
The 502 degrade test now passes because of the Time to PR footer note, which is always shown when `timeToPrMinutes` is absent. It no longer tests the cost-metrics degrade path it was written for.
The mobile "Median → PR" tile still hardcodes `—` and ignores the new `timeToPr` computed, so mobile and desktop disagree once the field arrives.
BoardView never reads a `lane` query parameter (a grep for `lane|query` finds only comments), so `/board?lane=needs-you` opens the board without filtering.
The older GH-139 docblock text still lists the tiles as "Delivered / Needs You / Cost-per-Shipped / Median", which contradicts the GH-249 paragraph below it.
